scripts.build: npm run build:console && node scripts/embed-migrations.mjs && esbuild apps/worker/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=apps/worker/dist/index.mjs
scripts.dev:celld: npm run build && celld dev apps/worker
scripts.dev:workerd: npm run build && wrangler dev --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc --local
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:console && node scripts/embed-migrations.mjs && tsc --noEmit
scripts.smoke:workerd: npm run build && npm run dev:secrets && node scripts/smoke-workerd.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:sql && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build && wrangler dev --config apps/worker/wrangler.demo.jsonc --local
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config apps/worker/wrangler.demo.jsonc --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply LIS_DB --config apps/worker/wrangler.demo.jsonc --remote && wrangler deploy --config apps/worker/wrangler.demo.jsonc
scripts.smoke:celld: npm run build && npm run dev:secrets && CELLD_BIN=${CELLD_BIN:-./.validation-tools/bin/celld} node scripts/smoke-workerd.mjs
